parental smoking and school personnel are both associated with adolescent health risk behaviours but parental smoking seems to have a stronger association.

parental smoking is associated with all health-risk behaviours among both sexes, and school personnel smoking is associated with smoking, alcohol use, illicit drug use and reporting adults smoking in school among boys.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between parental and school personnel (teacher and school nurse) smoking and adolescent health risk behaviours.
the association of parental and school staff smoking with health risk behaviours among adolescents.
the relationship between school personnel's smoking and adolescent smoking, drinking and drug use.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

parental smoking is a stronger predictor than smoking prevalence among school staff for adolescent smoking and alcohol use, whereas smoking prevalence among school employees is a stronger predictor for adolescent smoking cessation and illicit drug use.
parental smoking has a stronger association with health-risk behaviour among adolescents than school personnel smoking.
both school personnel and parents have a role to play in the prevention of adolescent smoking and health risk behaviours.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
school staff smoking is an important determinant of adolescents' health risk behaviour.

the smoking prevalence among parents and school personnel is associated with adolescent's smoking behaviours, alcohol consumption and illicit drug use and that parental smoking is a stronger predictor of these health risk behaviours than school personnel smoking.
parental smoking is the most important risk factor for adolescent health risk behaviours, but school personnel smoking also has an effect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
school personnel smoking is associated with adolescents' smoking behaviours and that this association is stronger among boys.
school staff smoking is an important target for health promotion efforts.
school personnel smoking is associated with adolescents' smoking, alcohol use, drug use and smoking cessation.
